title: Seedream gets a year-end promotion
summary:
A year-end Seedream promotion, a longer view of model health, and local Pollen balance tracking led a day of practical fixes.

Enter added 99%-off promotion badges for `seedream` and `seedream-pro`, alongside updated model descriptions and a Dec 31, 2025 end date in the announcement.

Model Monitor now defaults to a 60-minute health view, with a switch back to the existing 5-minute view. The longer window shows per-model request counts, status codes, and latency without making every brief wobble look like the whole story.

Donjon.studio joined the games directory with AI-generated interactive adventures, evolving stories, and images. App submission checks were also updated to handle special characters in names and fields.

highlights.title: A wider model-health view
highlights.text: Check model health over 60 minutes, or switch to the 5-minute view when you need a closer look. [Open Model Monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).
